card.name: Linking words before muscle-injury terms
card.fires_on: Commas, small linking words and punctuation placed just before an expected muscle-injury term such as myositis, myopathy, rhabdomyolysis or necrotizing myopathy, mostly in statin label text.

modes.label: Link before muscle term
modes.description: A comma, 'and', 'including', 'with', 'to' or 'showing' right before a muscle-damage word.
modes.example: Steps to Prevent or Reduce the Risk of Myopathy<< and>> Rhabdomyolysis Pitav

modes.label: Section reference
modes.description: An opening bracket after a skeletal muscle heading, before the section number.
modes.example: [see Warnings and Precautions , Skeletal Muscle<< (>>5.1) , Drug Interactions

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting muscle words such as muscle, skeletal and muscular next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a muscle-injury term is expected, mostly in statin warnings.
